items.why: The report fits the band with two components, "352.73 ± 0.32 (FWHM 10.17) and 358.46 ± 0.05," and assigns them to 2LA(M) and E2g1, but the E2g1 position (358.5 cm-1) is well off the about 355.2 cm-1 expected, and the spectra are not the two 514.5 nm spots in the case.
No 2LA(M)/A1g intensity ratio is given for either spot, and no monolayer fingerprint ratio is mentioned.
The report says A1g is "about 417.9 to 418.0 cm-1 in both spectra" and gives no stiffening from about 417.2 to 420.1 cm-1 between a thin and a thick spot.
No A1g minus E2g1 separation is reported for either spot.
Nothing is said about how weakly positions constrain 2L, 3L and bulk; layers are simply "not determined".
The report checks Si-line calibration ("Si offsets +1.355 and +0.298 cm-1"; "Was the spectrometer recalibrated between wavelengths?") and ties 2LA(M) visibility to excitation resonance.

wrong_claims.why: The report separates 2LA(M) and E2g1 into two components and builds no layer number on the band maximum.
2LA(M) is named as such; it is not called a defect or impurity peak.
